title: Pointwise convergence of noncommutative ergodic averages along the primes
summary: Let $\mathcal N$ be a von Neumann algebra equipped with a normal faithful semifinite trace, and let $γ$ be a trace-preserving automorphism of $\mathcal N$. We consider the ergodic averages along the prime numbers \[ A_N(x) := \frac1{|P_N|} \sum_{q\in P_N}γ^q(x), \qquad P_N:=\{q\leq N:q\ \text{is prime}\}. \] For every $1<p<\infty$, we prove a strong maximal inequality for $(A_N)_{N\geq2}$ on $L_p(\mathcal N)$ and that $A_N(x)$ converges bilaterally almost uniformly for every $x\in L_p(\mathcal N)$.
